messages:
Maya: Heads-up — ACME SI asked for a private offer that blends a 12mo commit, hardware rebate, and co-marketing fund. Need alignment on structure + renewal guardrails. They want a 50% commit discount if they hit >=80% consumption + $250k co-marketing credit tied to joint announcements.

AJ (sales): Is this going to be a Marketplace private offer SKU or a direct PO? They flagged marketplace listing to keep reseller flows.

ACME_SI: Marketplace preferred. We want the co-marketing fund escrowed and released on demo/announce milestones. Also need a hardware rebate we can invoice against.

Devon (product): We can create a commit SKU with tiers. Main q: do we allow carryover of unused commit into the next term? That affects SKU naming and billing.

Lina (finance): Prefer no carryover — monthly true-up + top-ups is safest for revenue recognition. Also we should gate co-marketing eligibility behind a minimum commit floor.

Nate (legal): We'll need clawback language for the co-marketing funds if milestones aren't met, and a clear definition of "consumption" — recommend using Redwood billed usage (tokens/embedding units) as the metric, not partner-reported numbers.

Maya: Draft proposal for discussion: 
```
- Term: 12 months, Commit: $1.2M prepaid equivalent
- Consumption metric: Redwood billed units (tokens + embeddings)
- Discount tiers at renewal: 
  * <70% utilization -> no additional rebate (standard committed pricing applies)
  * 70% - 89% -> 25% rebate applied as credit at renewal
  * >=90% -> 50% rebate applied as prepaid credit on renewal
- Co-marketing: $250k held in escrow; released in 3 tranches (POV demo, joint case study, public announce)
- Hardware rebate: one-time $200k payable after month 6 if utilization >=60%
- Renewal uplift/fallback: if utilization <60% at term end, pricing reverts to list price minus a 10% floor (to avoid abrupt churn)
```
Please react with :thumbsup: if this structure looks reasonable or flag issues.

AJ (sales): Tranches are good. Need to validate marketplace mechanics for escrow — ops will need to map SKU to private offer and escrow behavior. pinging ops-bot to check feasibility.

ops-bot: Marketplace private offers support SKU-level discounts and private SKUs. Escrowed co-marketing funds are not native — recommend we handle as an externally tracked accrual with payment triggers tied to signed milestone docs. Ops will need an "external-credit" SKU mapping for tracking.

ACME_SI: Fine with external accrual if it maps to milestone sign-offs. Can the second tranche require an approved public case study? That's a preference.

Nate (legal): Case study requirement OK but add opt-in approvals and a 45-day review window post-draft. Also add a clawback that pro-rates remaining co-marketing if ACME SI cancels or breaches.

Devon (product): I'll draft the SKU + listing plan and include a rollback path for lower tiers. Also propose enabling auto-fallback to a lower-cost quantized model variant if capacity constraints appear during high usage.

Lina (finance): I'll run modeling for revenue recognition and cashflow impact and check reserve treatment for the escrowed $250k. Expect numbers by Monday.

Maya: Action items — pls ack: 
- AJ: draft the Marketplace private offer terms in Partner Portal + internal draft by EOD Wed
- Nate: 1-page legal clause (clawback + case study approvals) by Fri
- Devon: SKU + listing + fallback plan by next Tue
- Lina: financial model + recognition guidance by Mon
- ACME_SI: confirm case study opt-in preference and milestone language by Thu

AJ (sales): Ack, on it.

ACME_SI: Ack, will confirm internal sign-off on case study clause and milestone cadence by Thu.

Maya: Thanks all — if no objections I'll convert this draft into a short term-sheet and circulate to ACME for signature.
